title: Senior Product Manager (Marketplace)
description:
Location: Full-time remote; work schedule is Sunday to Thursday, GMT +3. Remote work is available from 25+ countries. Potential opportunity to apply for a Qatar ID and relocate to Doha, Qatar.

Payment is made monthly in US dollars to a bank account using SWIFT.

Company

QIC is a Qatar-based insurance provider developing a digital ecosystem that combines insurance and non-insurance services through platforms including qic.online and the QIC app.

What you will do

- Own the Car Market product strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery and post-launch results across iOS, Android and web.

- Grow seller supply and buyer demand while improving the marketplace funnel from listing creation and moderation to search, seller contact and completed deal.

- Improve search, filtering, ranking, listing quality, pricing guidance, valuation products and car-history data.

- Own monetization through paid promotion, featured listings, dealer packages, subscriptions and lead-based models.

- Build dealer and supply-partner tooling, manage trust and safety, and work with Legal and Compliance on fraud, scams, disputes and misleading listings.

- Define marketplace metrics, run user research and A/B experiments, and lead a cross-functional squad with Engineering, Design, Data, QA, Marketing and Customer Support.

Requirements

- 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years owning a marketplace, classifieds, e-commerce or other two-sided consumer product.

- Proven experience with marketplace liquidity, supply-demand balance, listing-to-lead and lead-to-deal conversion, repeat usage and take rate.

- Experience shipping consumer mobile products at scale, with native iOS and Android as primary surfaces.

- Strong data skills, including SQL, Amplitude, GA4, Power BI or Tableau, and independent A/B test analysis.

- Experience with marketplace monetization, search and ranking, supply-partner tooling, user discovery and cross-functional squad leadership.

- Strong written and spoken English required. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

- Experience in automotive, classifieds, marketplaces or insurtech.

- Experience with the GCC or MENA market, especially Qatar.

- Arabic language skills and familiarity with motor insurance products.

- Experience with AI-driven moderation, pricing models or recommendation features.

Culture & Benefits

- Long-term service agreement contract with a 3-month probation period.

- Fully remote work in a distributed and multicultural environment with digital nomads across 25+ countries.

- Qatar holiday calendar, 20 vacation days and 10 sick days.

- Performance reviews twice a year with the possibility of a raise.

- Potential opportunity to apply for a Qatar ID and relocate to Doha, Qatar.
